utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces from Mara, so I’m still not totally sure—do you know if it’s definitely still on this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m actually still catching up too—I only know we’re planning the repair drive, but I haven’t heard a confirmed date yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes me feel a little better—I was worried I was the only one out of the loop. If you hear anything solid, let me know, because I’ve only got second-hand updates so far.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, we’ve got check-in and outreach covered, and Faye’s free midday between school runs—do you want me to slot her into a volunteer shift then?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please put Faye on the midday shift, and note her at check-in unless Maple Street needs an extra pair of hands by then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—I’ll put Faye on the midday shift for check-in and keep her flexible in case Maple Street needs an extra hand by then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around nine with the ladder and tool kit, and I can come a little early if you want help setting up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—nine, right. Yeah, that helps a lot; I’ll bring the toolbox too and head over once I get myself sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll plan on a little before nine with the ladder and tool kit, and we’ll get set up when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—I’m coming by soon, and if I forget what I’m meant to do, just point me at the next thing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Oren—come by the community shed, and I’ll point you to the next task when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, the community shed—right, I’m heading that way now, and I’ll just follow your lead when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the tape, markers, and boxes ready, so once Rosa sends the final times I’ll make sure everyone knows to meet by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether Rosa’s organizing it, then, and what the exact start time is before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s organizing the schedule, yes, but I’m still waiting on her final times tonight, so I can only confirm we’ll be meeting by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira, we could still use a few more hands at the repair drive—if you can swing by, I’d really appreciate it, and feel free to spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but text me if it gets urgent and I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira—I appreciate it, and I’ll keep spreading the word in the meantime. If we get in a pinch, I’ll text you right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’ve still got 12 Maple and 18 Oak on the list, and Noah’s supposed to bring tools if he makes it over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but can we confirm exactly which tools Noah’s bringing and whether anyone’s covering tape, screws, and gloves if he can’t make it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can’t confirm Noah’s exact tools yet, so plan as if he might miss it; I’d have someone else cover tape, screws, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hana, I’ve been pulling in people from the church group, block watch, and the school pickup crowd, so it’s starting to feel like we’ll have a solid mix of hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’s encouraging, Jules—do we already have the date, location, and repair types confirmed so we can tell everyone the same details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t gotten the full confirmed rundown yet, so I don’t want to send mixed details, but I’m checking with Opal and can pass Hana the exact date, place, and repair list as soon as she locks it in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — I’m finalizing the repair drive schedule now, so if you know any neighbors who still need details or help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I’ve only heard a little so far, but I’ll pass your name along if anyone asks and let you know if I hear of any needs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’s perfect, and I appreciate you keeping an ear out while I finish the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Uli, I heard Mara’s keeping a list, and I’m asking around too so we don’t come up short on the basics for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good. I can stop by for a little while if I’m able, but I can’t promise much right now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s kind of you, Uli—any little bit helps, and I’ll make sure Mara knows you might be able to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, how many volunteers do we actually have confirmed right now, and who’s still a maybe for this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right now Gus is confirmed for around nine with his ladder and drill, and I’m set to be there too. As for maybes, I don’t have anyone else clearly confirmed yet, so we should check in with the others and make a simple list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So that’s only two confirmed from your side—who are you checking with today, and when can you give me a firm count?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sam, can you confirm you’re organizing it and the exact start time? I’ve got the van brakes first once that’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m helping where needed, but Opal’s organizing the repair drive, and I’m headed to Maple Street first; I don’t have the exact start time yet, so let’s check with her.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—thanks. I’ll check with Opal for the exact time, and once that’s set I’m ready to jump in on the van brakes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Kira, we could still use a few more hands at the repair drive, so if you’re free even a little while, come by and help out—and feel free to spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s organizing it and the exact start time before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m helping organize it with Mara, and we’re starting at 10 in the morning—if that works for you, I’d love to have you, and please pass it along if you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Last I heard, we’ve got three confirmed and a couple of maybes, but I’m still out running errands—if Vik hears anything firm, have them text me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll text you if anything firm comes in, but the plan I’m repeating is still to meet by the community shed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—if the volunteer count changes or anything urgent comes up, text me and I’ll head over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, Gus is set to come by around nine with his ladder and drill, so let’s have the repair list ready and start in a clear order.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay. I can help keep the list tidy and make sure we start with the small fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Rey. If we sort the list before nine, we can put Gus right onto the bigger jobs and keep the morning moving cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Faye, can we confirm the date, location, and which repair services we’re planning to offer before we go any further?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes—let’s lock in the date and location first, and for services I’d really like us to prioritize the carpool van brakes since I need it safe for school drop-offs this week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—before we decide, can you confirm which day this week you need the van ready, and do we already have a location option for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces myself—do you know if it’s still on for this weekend, or should I check with Jules?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think Sam’s organizing it and it’s around 9, but I’d check with Jules to confirm before you plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ve mostly been hearing things second-hand too, so I’ll check with Jules before I bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m on it—I’ve been connecting the church group, block watch, and school pickup folks so we can match up hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great—sorry, I’m coming in late, but do we already have a date and spot picked out for it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the final date and spot confirmed yet, but Opal’s the one keeping the main list, so I can check with her and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—still on, then? I’ll try to bring the toolbox over in a bit, unless I get turned around again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If you can, let Mara know exactly what’s in the toolbox before you head over—I’d hate for us to assume we’ve got essentials covered when we don’t.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, yeah, I should check first. I’ll look in the toolbox and tell Mara what’s actually in there before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—Sam’s checking the fence panels on Maple Street first, and I’m waiting on Jules’s headcount from the church group, block watch, and school pickup line.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—12 Maple and 18 Oak still need help on my end. Send me Jules’s headcount when it lands, and I’ll match people up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Leo—I’ve got 12 Maple and 18 Oak noted, and I’ll send Jules’s headcount over as soon as it comes in so we can place folks block by block.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit and see what I can manage, but I may need to head out early.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That still helps a lot—if you can, meet me on Maple Street and we’ll start with the fence panels first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll come by Maple Street and help with the fence panels for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mina, I heard Mara’s keeping a little list, so I’m asking around to make sure we’ve got the basics covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people are actually confirmed right now, and who’s still just a maybe?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, from what I’ve heard, only a handful are firmly confirmed so far, and a few others are still maybes—I can ask Mara for the latest count if you like.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—yes, I’m heading over soon, and I can still lend a hand even without my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s great, Oren — we’re meeting by the community shed, and I’ve already got tape, markers, and boxes ready if you want to help sort things.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, sorting I can do—just point me at the boxes, would you, in case I get turned around on the way to the shed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around nine with the ladder and my tool kit, and I can come a little early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Gus—if you can come a little early, let’s have you help with setup and keep the ladder handy once things get going.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Mara—I’ll come a bit early and have the ladder and tool kit with me so we’re ready to go.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
